nuget_v3_index.note: Use the project-scoped URL (preferred). Set FOUNDRY_VALIDATION_NUGET_FEED to the project_scoped value.

npm_registry.note: Set FOUNDRY_VALIDATION_NPM_REGISTRY to the url value above. The harness writes the _authToken line only when FOUNDRY_VALIDATION_FEED_TOKEN is non-empty.

pip_index.note: Set FOUNDRY_VALIDATION_PIP_INDEX to the url value above. For authenticated access embed credentials in the URL as https://pat:TOKEN@pkgs.dev.azure.com/... or use the artifacts-keyring package.

auth_notes.pat_scope_required: Packaging (Read) — Azure DevOps Personal Access Token
auth_notes.how_to_obtain: Azure DevOps -> User Settings -> Personal Access Tokens -> New Token -> Scopes: Packaging: Read
auth_notes.public_feed_assessment: ORT-Nightly is hosted in the 'PublicPackages' project of the 'aiinfra' Azure DevOps organisation. The project name implies public visibility; project-scoped feeds inherit project visibility, so anonymous read may be allowed without a PAT. Org-level policies can still restrict anonymous access. ASSUMPTION: set FOUNDRY_VALIDATION_FEED_TOKEN to a PAT with Packaging:Read for CI reliability; on a truly public feed the token is ignored harmlessly.

env_var_mapping.FOUNDRY_VALIDATION_NUGET_FEED: NuGet v3 index URL; credentials supplied via per-run nuget.config packageSourceCredentials using FOUNDRY_VALIDATION_FEED_TOKEN as ClearTextPassword (Username='pat')
env_var_mapping.FOUNDRY_VALIDATION_NPM_REGISTRY: npm registry URL; _authToken supplied via per-run .npmrc using FOUNDRY_VALIDATION_FEED_TOKEN
env_var_mapping.FOUNDRY_VALIDATION_PIP_INDEX: pip --index-url value; credentials embedded in URL or via keyring using FOUNDRY_VALIDATION_FEED_TOKEN
env_var_mapping.FOUNDRY_VALIDATION_FEED_TOKEN: Azure DevOps PAT with Packaging:Read scope; consumed by all three ecosystems
